Your Trusted Export Partner for Authentic Indonesian Products

PT Arisyafood Global Niaga is an export trading company based in Medan, Indonesia. We specialize in bringing the finest Indonesian agricultural products—including premium spices, raw crackers, and vegetarian snacks—to the global market with uncompromising quality.

visibility

Our Vision

To be Indonesia's most trusted export partner, recognized globally for quality, consistency, and the richness of Indonesian culinary heritage.

Quality Assured

Zero compromise on product quality. We ensure all our products meet strict international certification standards and food safety compliance.
